zones.name: South Urban Street & Outer Brick Wall
zones.description: Player Start at (30, 20) in dark rain-slicked alley; continuous 4m brick perimeter wall along y=80.0 with main sliding truck gate at (250, 80), side service door at (75, 80), and low ventilation shaft entry (env_vent_shaft_2m) at (45, 80).

zones.name: Southern Container Yard & Floodlight Grid
zones.description: Maze of 20ft and 40ft shipping containers and overhead gantry cranes illuminated by 3 tall floodlight poles wired to Master Breaker Box inside utility shed at (150, 150) (S1); watched by panning camera M04_CAM_01 (250, 120) and Tripwire Alarms M04_T1_01 (140, 95) and M04_T1_02 (310, 110).

zones.name: Main Warehouse Interior
zones.description: Massive enclosed brick-and-steel warehouse with 4 entry routes (front shutter doors, back loading bay doors, roof skylight access via exterior ladder, and vent shaft network), protected by Motion Sensors M04_T6_01 (205, 215) & M04_T6_02 (280, 240), Pressure Plates M04_T7_01 (160, 230) & M04_T7_02 (320, 275), and fixed camera M04_CAM_02 (375, 220).

zones.name: Interrogation & Holding Cell Block
zones.description: Reinforced inner room complex inside the North-West corner of the warehouse (R1 Guard Room, R2 Security Control Room with camera monitor M04_MON_01 and Alarm Panel M04_ALM_01, R3 Locked Holding Cell at (190, 290) housing Informant chr_npc_informant for O1).

zones.name: North Rear Loading Dock & Escape Yard
zones.description: Rear cargo bay and truck dock leading to Extraction Point at (470, 380) (radius 10.0m) where both Player and Informant must reach safely.

primary.title: Free informant at (190, 290) and escort him alive to rear dock at (470, 380)

secondary.title: Turn off 3 floodlights at breaker box (150, 150)
Complete the entire mission with ZERO kills (non-lethal takedowns / pure stealth only)

extraction.title: Escort Informant & Extract at Rear Loading Dock (470, 380)

events.description: At elapsed >= 360s, container yard patrols and indoor warehouse floor patrols rotate positions.
If alert_level == 3, heavy steel warehouse shutters lock down immediately and a reinforcement cargo truck (veh_truck_cargo_a) with 4 troops spawns outside.

silent.name: Silent Route (West Ventilation Shaft, Prone Motion Sensor Bypass & Dark Container Escort)
silent.description: Start at (30, 20), crawl through low ventilation shaft at (45, 80) along West wall (45, 290), enter Warehouse & Cell Block West vent/doorways to free Informant at (190, 290), exit North hatch to (190, 380), and escort along dark North dock to (470, 380).

technical.name: Technical Route (Floodlight Breaker Shutoff S1, Camera Monitor Hack & EMP Sensor Disable)
technical.description: Move from (30, 20) through side service door to Utility Shed at (150, 150) to shut off 3 floodlights (S1), enter Warehouse South-West door at (150, 240), hack camera monitor & unlock Holding Cell at (190, 290), exit North dock door to (190, 380), and extract at (470, 380).

loud.name: Loud Route (Roof Skylight Breach, Zone C Cobalt Squad Clear & North Dock Defense)
loud.description: Advance from (30, 20) to main truck gate approach (310, 75), climb exterior ladder to Roof Skylight at (310, 290), breach Cell Block East door to free Informant at (190, 290), push out North dock (190, 380), and fight to Extraction at (470, 380).

structures.description: Utility shed at (150, 150) containing Master Breaker Box (prop_breaker_box_a) for S1.
Central yard security post supporting panning camera M04_CAM_01 at (250, 120).
Interior East mezzanine pillar supporting fixed Security Camera M04_CAM_02 at (375, 220).
Warehouse West ventilation shaft network entry.
